mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ${tableName} WHERE path LIKE CONCAT(#{pathPrefix}, '%') ORDER BY path ASC, sort_order ASC

WITH RECURSIVE tree_cte AS ( SELECT * FROM ${tableName} WHERE id = #{rootId} UNION ALL SELECT t.* FROM ${tableName} t INNER JOIN tree_cte tc ON t.parent_id = tc.id ) SELECT * FROM tree_cte ORDER BY path ASC, sort_order ASC

WITH RECURSIVE tree_cte AS ( SELECT * FROM ${tableName} WHERE id = #{nodeId} UNION ALL SELECT t.* FROM ${tableName} t INNER JOIN tree_cte tc ON t.id = tc.parent_id ) SELECT * FROM tree_cte ORDER BY level ASC, sort_order ASC

WITH RECURSIVE tree_cte AS ( SELECT * FROM ${tableName} WHERE id = #{nodeId} UNION ALL SELECT t.* FROM ${tableName} t INNER JOIN tree_cte tc ON t.id = tc.parent_id ) SELECT * FROM tree_cte ORDER BY level ASC
